treasureInfoTitle: Legend of the Bell at Monastery Pond
treasureInfoStory: A Benedictine monastery once stood in St. Georgen. To supply the monks with fish, the Monastery Pond was dammed. According to legend, an ox team carrying bells sank there after sliding down the hillside. The bells were meant for the church up in town.
